symptom: Production vacation-2574 shows one bedroom and 'איפה תשנו ביחידה?' inside its unit card, but the main #sleeping / 'איפה תשנו?' section is missing.
expected_behavior: Every vacation place with a verified positive bedroom count displays the main sleeping section; explicit bedroom groups remain separate cards and missing data is never invented.
environment: Production v715, https://vii.spaplus.co/business?id=vacation-2574, 2026-10-28, supplier snapshot and live-detail mapping in release/v646-four-gaps.

steps: Observe the unit card's verified one-bedroom fact.
Inspect the page for #sleeping and the main 'איפה תשנו?' heading.
reproduction.evidence: Production DOM: bedroom text exists, body includes 'איפה תשנו ביחידה?', but #sleeping is absent.

observations.observation: The accepted supplier snapshot for vacation-2574 contains room id 4396 with bedrooms=1 and feature 'מיטה זוגית'.
The room feature group is titled 'צימרבוס', not 'חדר שינה 1'.
verifiedSleepingRooms currently discards every group whose title does not match isVerifiedBedroomGroup, and has no room.bedrooms fallback.

hypotheses.mechanism: The supplier omitted bedroom data for vacation-2574.
hypotheses.prediction: Both snapshot and unit card would lack a positive bedroom count.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Inspect the accepted supplier detail and production unit-card facts.
hypotheses.result: Rejected: both expose one verified bedroom; the snapshot also exposes a double bed.

hypotheses.mechanism: The main sleeping mapper requires a bedroom-like group title and silently drops otherwise valid room-level bedroom data.
hypotheses.prediction: A room with bedrooms=1 and group title 'צימרבוס' shows the unit-card fallback but produces zero verifiedSleepingRooms.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Compare the mapper predicate with the vacation-2574 supplier shape and production DOM.
hypotheses.result: Supported: the title fails isVerifiedBedroomGroup, leaving #sleeping absent while the unit card still shows one bedroom.

hypotheses.mechanism: The sleeping section is present but hidden by responsive CSS.
hypotheses.prediction: #sleeping would exist in the DOM on production even if not visible.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Query the exact production DOM for #sleeping.
hypotheses.result: Rejected: #sleeping is not rendered at all.

fix.change: Pending: add a verified room-level bedroom fallback after the explicit bedroom-group branch, limited to positive bedroom counts and supplier-provided sleeping facts.

affected_family: vacation places with explicit bedroom groups
vacation places with positive bedroom counts but generic group titles
desktop and mobile vacation place pages
remaining_unknowns: Exact number of supplier vacation records affected by generic group titles will be measured after the shared mapper exists.
authorization_boundary: Authorized shared vacation place-page repair, tests and production publication; no supplier data mutation or unrelated product change.
